## Highlights

- Cargo packages now keep only binaries that belong to the project (`<project>` or `<project>-*`); unrelated workspace helpers and galleries are no longer packaged when a matching application binary exists.
- GitHub releases now carry curated Highlights and Changes, with retroactive notes for alpha.30 and alpha.31.

## Changes

- Filter Cargo staging by project name, with a full-binary fallback when no project-named binary matches.
- Add curated release notes under `.github/release-notes/` and use them in the release workflow; missing files fall back to a generated commit list.
- Validate Cargo workspace staging on a real application: only its application binaries remain in the package.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.31...v0.2.0-alpha.32
